definitions.explanation: A dark surface for writing on with chalk, used in classrooms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{黒板|こくばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The teacher wrote on the blackboard.

examples.japanese: {黒板|こくばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}して→消す：00528_kesu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{黒板|こくばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さくて→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The writing on the blackboard is too small to see.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{黒板|こくばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧、⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}えさせた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher wrote a problem on the blackboard and had the students answer it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{黒板|こくばん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The blackboard at the front of the classroom is large, so the writing is easy to see even from the back seats.

notes:
{黒板|こくばん} is a classroom blackboard.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦チョーク→チョーク：24407_chooku⟧ (chalk)
- ⟦{黒板|こくばん}{消|け}し→黒板消し：24875_kokubankeshi⟧ (blackboard eraser)
- ⟦{黒板|こくばん}{拭|ふ}き→黒板拭き：28097_kokubanfuki⟧ (blackboard cleaning cloth)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {黒板|こくばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write on the blackboard)
- {黒板|こくばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ (to erase the blackboard)
- {黒板|こくばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look at the blackboard)

MODERN ALTERNATIVE:
- ⟦ホワイトボード→ホワイトボード：23126_howaitoboodo⟧ (whiteboard)
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{黒板|こくばん} (electronic whiteboard)

NOTE: Despite the name (⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ = black), modern school blackboards are often green.
